abstract: A 4-year-old well boy was seen because of an asymptomatic left testicle undescended since birth; the testis was not palpable and the right side was normal. After an episode of left lower quadrant and left hip area pain, with some bladder symptoms and left leg limping, a work-up including a CAT scan showed a calcified retroperitoneal pelvic tumor on the left side. At laparotomy, an infarcted mass was found in the pelvis just above the internal ring. It was a torsion of an undescended intraabdominal testis with a benign testicular teratoma. The tumor was removed and his recovery was uneventful.
abstract_ja: 4歳の健康な男児が、出生時から触知しない左精巣の無症候性停留に関して受診した。左下腹部および左股関節部の痛み、膀胱症状、左脚の跛行のエピソードの後、CTを含む精査で骨盤左側の石灰化を伴う後腹膜腫瘤が示された。開腹手術では、左内鼠径輪の直上の骨盤内に梗塞した腫瘤が認められた。これは、良性精巣奇形腫を伴う腹腔内停留精巣の捻転であった。腫瘍を切除し、経過は順調であった。
